    Orthogonality of glued bricks #

    For a pairwise Hom-orthogonal family of bricks C, B i with non-split extension classes (α i, β i) and subsets S, S' of the index set, the glued modules E_S and E_{S'} (Bricks.subExt) satisfy Hom(E_S, E_{S'}) = 0 when S ⊄ S' (Bricks.hom_subExt_eq_zero): a component B_j, j ∈ S \ S', forces the scalar on C to vanish.
